topics.title: New Jersey bans surveillance pricing
topics.summary: New Jersey has banned retailers from using shoppers’ personal data to charge different prices for identical essential goods. The law also pauses new electronic shelf labels for a year while officials study their effects.
topics.discussionPrompt: If two people buy the same thing, should they always see the same price? Where would you draw the line between a useful personalized discount and unfair data-driven pricing?

topics.title: Eating earlier may support sharper thinking
topics.summary: A small preliminary study found that older women who ate within a nine-hour window and stopped four hours before bed performed better on some problem-solving tests. Researchers say larger, peer-reviewed studies are still needed.
topics.discussionPrompt: Would you try changing when you eat if it might help your brain, or is a late-night snack too important? What makes a health habit feel realistic enough to keep?

topics.title: King Kazu scores at age 59
topics.summary: Japanese football legend Kazuyoshi Miura scored his first competitive goal in nearly four years as Fukushima United advanced in the Emperor’s Cup. The 59-year-old is preparing for his 42nd professional season.
topics.discussionPrompt: Is staying in the game for decades more impressive than going out at your peak? What hobby or job could you imagine happily doing into your sixties?

topics.title: Pirelli calendar puts India in the frame
topics.summary: The 2027 Pirelli calendar will feature an all-Indian cast and was shot entirely in India for the first time. Locations and creative ideas draw on the country’s landscapes, traditions and contemporary fashion scene.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a global brand spotlights one country, what makes it feel like a real celebration instead of just a stylish backdrop? Which local place would you choose for a photo shoot?
